description:
Live telemetry for one currently-RUNNING task, re-estimated as it
executes (the Pollux-style "don't trust the static upfront estimate"
argument from ``SCHEDULING.md`` §5). ``remaining_*`` fields are what
``ADAPTIVE_COMPUTE.md`` §3.1's stopping function calls ``g_hat(t)``/
``c_hat(t)`` — explicitly *remaining*, not total-so-far, so sunk cost
never enters the stop/continue comparison.

evidence_accumulated.description: Cumulative realized evidence gain observed so far.
evidence_accumulated.title: Evidence Accumulated

remaining_cost_estimate_usd.description: Live re-estimate of remaining cost to completion (c_hat(t)). Falls back to (task.estimated_cost_usd - cost_spent_usd), floored at 0, when not supplied.
remaining_cost_estimate_usd.title: Remaining Cost Estimate Usd

remaining_evidence_gain_estimate.description: Live re-estimate of remaining expected evidence gain (g_hat(t)). Falls back to task.expected_evidence_gain when not supplied.
remaining_evidence_gain_estimate.title: Remaining Evidence Gain Estimate

title: TaskProgressV1
